select * from (select cc.contract_id, cc.contract_name, cc.contract_number, pp.approval_number, cc.finance_amount, cc.contract_status, (select hbm.bp_name from hls_bp_master hbm where hbm.bp_id = cc.tenant_id) bp_name, 'CON_CONTRACT' document_category, (select sum(ccc.principal-ccc.received_principal) from con_contract_cashflow ccc where ccc.contract_id = cc.contract_id and ccc.cf_item = 1 and ccc.cf_status='RELEASE') unreceived_principal, (select sum(ccc.interest-ccc.received_interest) from con_contract_cashflow ccc where ccc.contract_id = cc.contract_id and ccc.cf_item = 1 and ccc.cf_status='RELEASE') unreceived_interest, ( select max(bm.bp_name) from prj_project_bp pb join hls_bp_master bm on pb.bp_id=bm.bp_id where pb.bp_categroy='CON_CONTRACT' and pb.bp_type='TENANT' and pb.project_id=cc.project_id) sal_bp_name, ( select max(bm.bp_name) from prj_project_bp pb join hls_bp_master bm on pb.bp_id=bm.bp_id where pb.bp_categroy='CON_CONTRACT' and pb.bp_type='TENANT_SEC' and pb.project_id=cc.project_id) buy_bp_name from con_contract cc,prj_project pp where cc.data_class = 'NORMAL' and pp.project_id=cc.project_id and cc.contract_status not in ('CANCEL','TERMINATE') UNION select fc.contract_id, fc.contract_name, fc.contract_number, fc.approval_number, fc.finance_amount, fc.contract_status, (SELECT max(hbm.bp_name) FROM fct_project_bp fpb, hls_bp_master hbm WHERE fpb.project_id = fc.project_id AND hbm.bp_id = fpb.bp_id AND fpb.CREDIT_GRANTOR_PARTY = 'Y') bp_name, 'FCT_CONTRACT' document_category, (select sum(fqc.due_amount-fqc.write_off_amount) from fct_quotation_cashflow fqc where fqc.contract_id = fc.contract_id and fqc.cf_item = 54 and fqc.cf_status = 'RELEASE') unreceived_principal, (select sum(fqc.due_amount-fqc.write_off_amount) from fct_quotation_cashflow fqc where fqc.contract_id = fc.contract_id and fqc.cf_item in (55,56,57,58) and fqc.cf_status = 'RELEASE') unreceived_interest, ( SELECT max(hbm.bp_name) FROM fct_project_bp fpb JOIN hls_bp_master hbm ON hbm.bp_id=fpb.bp_id WHERE fpb.bp_role_type='SELLER' AND fpb.project_id=fp.project_id) sal_bp_name, ( SELECT max(hbm.bp_name) FROM fct_project_bp fpb JOIN hls_bp_master hbm ON hbm.bp_id=fpb.bp_id WHERE fpb.bp_role_type='BUYER' AND fpb.project_id=fp.project_id) buy_bp_name from fct_contract fc JOIN fct_project fp ON fc.project_id=fp.project_id where fc.data_class = 'NORMAL' and fc.contract_status not in ('CANCEL','END')) t1
1=1
and t1.document_category = #{documentCategory}
and t1.contract_number LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{contractNumber}),'%')
and t1.approval_number LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{approvalNumber}),'%')
and t1.contract_name LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{contractName}),'%')
and t1.contract_status in ('INCEPT')

SELECT lcp.purpose_id, lcp.contract_id, lcp.purpose_doc_category, lcp.purpose_doc_id, lcp.purpose_amount, lcp.financing_amount, lcp.own_capital, lcp.description, lcp.withdraw_id, lcp.data_type, lcp.purpose_type, lcp.lon_company_id, con.contract_name purpose_doc_name, con.contract_number, con.approval_number purpose_doc_number, con.sal_bp_name, con.buy_bp_name FROM lon_contract_purpose lcp LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cc.contract_id, cc.contract_name, cc.contract_number, pp.approval_number, ( select max(bm.bp_name) from prj_project_bp pb join hls_bp_master bm on pb.bp_id=bm.bp_id where pb.bp_categroy='CON_CONTRACT' and pb.bp_type='TENANT' and pb.project_id=cc.project_id) sal_bp_name, ( select max(bm.bp_name) from prj_project_bp pb join hls_bp_master bm on pb.bp_id=bm.bp_id where pb.bp_categroy='CON_CONTRACT' and pb.bp_type='TENANT_SEC' and pb.project_id=cc.project_id) buy_bp_name, 'CON_CONTRACT' document_category FROM con_contract cc join prj_project pp on pp.project_id=cc.project_id WHERE cc.data_class = 'NORMAL' UNION SELECT fc.contract_id, fc.contract_name, fc.contract_number, fc.approval_number, ( SELECT MAX(hbm.bp_name) FROM fct_project_bp fpb JOIN hls_bp_master hbm ON hbm.bp_id=fpb.bp_id WHERE fpb.bp_role_type='SELLER' AND fpb.project_id=fp.project_id) sal_bp_name, ( SELECT MAX(hbm.bp_name) FROM fct_project_bp fpb JOIN hls_bp_master hbm ON hbm.bp_id=fpb.bp_id WHERE fpb.bp_role_type='BUYER' AND fpb.project_id=fp.project_id) buy_bp_name, 'FCT_CONTRACT' document_category FROM fct_contract fc JOIN fct_project fp ON fc.project_id=fp.project_id WHERE fc.data_class = 'NORMAL' UNION SELECT cc.contract_id, cc.contract_name, cc.contract_number, cc.major_contract_number approval_number, NULL sal_bp_name, NULL buy_bp_name, 'LON_CONTRACT' document_category FROM lon_contract cc WHERE cc.data_class = 'NORMAL' ) con ON con.contract_id=lcp.purpose_doc_id AND con.document_category=lcp.purpose_doc_category
1=1 and lcp.withdraw_id = #{withdrawId}
select nvl(sum(lcp.financing_amount),0) from lon_contract_purpose lcp where lcp.withdraw_id=#{withdrawId}
